optimizedDescription.value: Reports provider-computed blast radius for files, symbols, specs, or public exports with typed, workspace, and category filters.

optimizedContext.value:
# Graph Impact

## Rules

### Command & selectors
- Signature: `specd graph impact [--file <paths...> | --symbol <reference> | --spec <id> | --export <public-name> --from <file-or-surface>] [--direction dependents|dependencies|upstream|downstream|both] [--depth <n>] [--include-tests] [--include-ignored] [--all] [--category <categories>] [--type <types>] [--kind <kinds>] [--workspace <workspace>] [--exclude-workspace <workspace>] [--config <path> | --path <path>] [--format text|json|toon]`.
- Require exactly one target family. `--export` and `--from` required together; mutually exclusive with file/symbol/spec. Missing half fails before provider open. `--config` and `--path` mutually exclusive.
- Normalize direction aliases before delegation. Existing direction/depth/context/format semantics retained. `--symbol` targets canonical logical symbol; `--export` one public binding on one surface. CLI never resolves either.
- Unqualified symbol: prefer unique case-exact name; multiple case-exact → bounded deterministic ambiguity, no traversal; only absent case-exact permits case-insensitive exact-name. Reject prefix/component/text matches. Qualified/full occurrence selectors retain exact semantics.

### Provider-owned filters
- Every target supports `--type <types>`, `--kind <kinds>`, repeatable `--workspace`, repeatable `--exclude-workspace`, `--include-tests`, `--include-ignored`, `--all`, `--category <categories>`.
- `--type`/`--kind`: comma-separated. Types: `files`, `symbols`, `specs`; documents unsupported. Kinds use shared Code Graph vocabulary. `--kind` with `--type` lacking `symbols` → usage error.
- Workspace filters use `graph search` normalization/matching; repeated inclusions/exclusions form sets; exclusion wins overlap.
- Categories: `source`, `test`, `ignored` only. Default `source`; inclusion flags add category; `--all` admits all; `--category` strictly restricts to listed values.
- CLI validates/normalizes one typed filter request and passes through selected provider operation. Never post-filter returned files/symbols/specs/kinds. All renderers consume provider-filtered result with pure display-path projection.
- `--type specs` valid for symbol/export targets; render provider `affectedSpecs`.

### Target execution
- File: resolve through `cli:graph-cli-context`; open via `withProvider`; provider aggregates changed symbols, affected files/symbols, counts, risk. Unresolved/ambiguous unprefixed paths fail.
- Symbol: resolve graph context; provider shared resolver accepts bare names, file-qualified selectors, location-backed graph IDs, canonical logical IDs, owner-qualified members. No match → message and exit 0. One → `analyzeImpact`; multiple bare/file-qualified → analyze all. Owner-qualified `qualified_name`: one analyzes; several report candidates without guess; zero reports none; file qualifier only filters. CLI never splits syntax or queries storage.
- Spec: `getSpec(specId)` then `analyzeSpecImpact`; missing node propagates `SpecNotFoundError`, exit 1, `SPEC_NOT_FOUND`. Include requirement-aware `DEPENDS_ON`, `COVERS_FILE`, `COVERS_SYMBOL` reachability.
- Export: after conservative target resolution, provider exact public-binding lookup; never filter capped/ranked search. Render binding, canonical logical target, ordered chain; separate exact-binding consumers from full canonical-symbol impact. Ambiguity returns deterministic candidates without merge/selection; preserve both views/provenance in all formats.
- Platform symbols from `@specd/sdk`; provider lifecycle only through `withProvider`.

### Availability, projection & output
- Delegate impact analysis and path projection to `sdk:run-graph-impact`.
- Exactly one provider-owned availability/staleness check after open; none per target/result. `GRAPH_BUSY`, `GRAPH_PROVIDER_STALE`, or open failure → infrastructure path, exit 3.
- Project/workspace-config-only path projection; no graph reads/provider document resolution. Multi-file input uses each file workspace config; render each affected file once per contributing input. No per-file/symbol provider/store fan-out or `StoreOverloadError` from result width.
- Text: target/depth, risk, aggregate counts, changed symbols, affected files with `name:line (d=N)`, and per-symbol/file breakdown. Multiple symbols render sequential analyses. File-only `IMPORTS` reachability renders without symbols. Nondefault depth shown. Upstream aliases describe dependent counts; downstream aliases dependency counts.
- Filter omissions in text: show test/ignored counts and inclusion guidance when `omittedCounts` nonzero.
- JSON/TOON emit full result unchanged, including `omittedCounts`, `AffectedSymbol.depth`, aggregate risk/counts, canonical `targets`, `projectRelativeTargets`, and target/affected `canonicalPath` plus `projectRelativePath`; never `displayPath`/`displayTargets`. Affected paths project-relative.
- File covering specs come only from provider. Text: depth-0 evidence under direct target coverage; minimum depth >0 under blast-radius coverage; mixed spec once in direct group. JSON/TOON preserve ordered `coveringSpecs` and every `{ kind, target, depth }`. Retain file coverage without symbol coverage and graph-health warnings.

## Constraints
- CLI MUST NOT compute symbol/export resolution, traversal, risk, coverage, multi-file aggregation, or post-provider result filtering.
- CLI owns console rendering and display formatting; platform types/lifecycle from `@specd/sdk`.
- Call `process.exit(0)` explicitly after provider closes.
